passages.title: The Language of the Hive
passages.text: Honeybees communicate the location of food through a remarkable behaviour known as the waggle dance. When a forager finds a rich source of nectar, she returns to the hive and moves in a figure-of-eight pattern on the vertical honeycomb. The straight middle part of the figure, during which she waggles her body, carries the message. The angle of this run relative to the vertical shows the direction of the food in relation to the sun, while the length of the waggle reveals the distance: the longer the waggle, the farther the flowers. Other workers crowd around, touch the dancer with their antennae, and then fly out to the exact spot. Scientists once doubted that insects could pass on such precise information, but decades of careful experiments have confirmed it. The discovery earned the Austrian researcher Karl von Frisch a Nobel Prize in 1973. Today, the dance is studied not only by biologists but also by engineers, who hope to design robots that cooperate as efficiently as a hive.

passages.title: The Village Well
passages.text:
The village well lies dry and still,
Its rope hangs limp upon the hill;
Yet children gather, laughing, near,
As if the water's song were here.
The old banyan, grey with years,
Has watched our hopes and silent fears;
It does not speak, but, bending low,
It shelters all who come and go.
The crows still gather on its crown,
The evening sun comes slowly down,
And every sparrow knows the way
Back to its branches at close of day.
The potter's wheel has ceased to turn,
No kiln-fires in the evening burn;
Yet in the dust, where footprints lie,
The past is whispering a lullaby.
So let us keep the old tree's name,
Its shade, its story, and its flame,
For what we guard in memory's hand
Will green again in thirsty land.

passages.title: The Silent Library
passages.text: Public libraries were once the quiet heart of every town. Today many of them stand half-empty, their shelves dusty and their reading rooms silent. Critics say the reason is obvious: smartphones have replaced books. This explanation is convenient but incomplete. A library fails when it is treated as a storeroom rather than a living space. Few libraries in small towns stay open after office hours, when working people could actually visit; fewer still buy new titles or host story-telling hours for children. If the doors are closed at the very time readers are free, can we blame the readers for staying away? Governments must therefore regard libraries not as an expense but as an investment in an informed citizenry. Modest steps, such as longer opening hours, a few new books each month and a corner for children, could bring back footfalls. A nation that reads, thinks; and a nation that thinks is difficult to mislead.

questions.question: The number of applicants ___ increasing every year.
questions.explanation: 'The number of' takes a singular verb (the subject is 'number'), so 'is'. ('A number of' would take a plural verb.)

questions.question: By the time the chief guest arrived, the students ___ the hall.
questions.explanation: Two past actions: the one completed earlier takes the Past Perfect ('had decorated'), the later one the Simple Past ('arrived'). 'Have decorated' is Present Perfect, 'were decorate' is ungrammatical and 'decorate' is Simple Present.

questions.question: Identify the type of the clause 'where she had kept the key' in: 'She could not tell me where she had kept the key.'
questions.explanation: The clause is the object of the verb 'tell' and answers 'what could she not tell?', so it is a noun clause. It does not modify a noun (not relative), does not modify a verb as time/place/reason (not adverb), and it has a finite verb 'had kept' (not non-finite).

questions.question: Convert into a complex sentence: 'Being ill, he could not attend the party.'
options: Though he was ill, he could not attend the party.
If he was ill, he could not attend the party.
He was ill and could not attend the party.
As he was ill, he could not attend the party.
questions.explanation: The participle phrase 'Being ill' expresses reason, so it becomes the subordinate clause 'As he was ill'. 'Though' and 'If' change the meaning; the third option is compound.

questions.question: Choose the correct indirect form: She said, "I have finished my work."
options: She said that she has finished her work.
She said that she had finished her work.
She said that I had finished my work.
She said that she would finish her work.
questions.explanation: With a past reporting verb, present perfect changes to past perfect and 'I/my' becomes 'she/her': 'had finished her work'.

questions.question: Only after the results were announced ___ the truth.
questions.explanation: After 'Only after + clause' at the beginning, the main clause takes inversion: 'did he realise'.

questions.question: Provided that it ___ tomorrow, we shall go for a picnic.
questions.explanation: 'Provided that' works like 'if' and takes the present simple for a future condition: 'does not rain'.

questions.question: Which of the following is an elliptical sentence?
options: She said that she would come.
Though he was ill, he came.
The boy who was late was punished.
questions.explanation: In 'Some like tea, others coffee' the verb 'like' is omitted in the second part to avoid repetition, which is ellipsis. The other sentences are complete and contain no omitted words.

questions.question: He has ___ friends, so he never feels lonely.
questions.explanation: 'Friends' is a countable plural noun and the sense is positive (some friends), so 'a few' is correct. 'A little' and 'little' go with uncountable nouns, and 'much' is not used with countable nouns.

questions.question: He ___ be at home; I saw him leaving for the office a moment ago.
questions.explanation: 'Can't' expresses logical impossibility (negative deduction), which fits because the speaker has just seen him leave. 'Must' expresses a positive deduction, 'needn't' absence of necessity and 'shall' is not suitable here.

questions.question: I am late, ___?
questions.explanation: The standard tag for 'I am' is 'aren't I?'. 'Amn't I' is not used in standard English.

questions.question: In the sentence 'To err is human', the phrase 'To err' is ___.
questions.explanation: 'To + base verb' is an infinitive (here used as the subject). A gerund ends in -ing and a participle is -ing/-ed.

questions.question: The meeting has been ___ till next Monday.
questions.explanation: 'Put off' means 'to postpone'. 'Put on' means to wear, 'put out' means to extinguish and 'put up' means to display or accommodate.

questions.question: Each of the students ___ given a certificate.
questions.explanation: 'Each' is a singular subject, so the verb must be singular: 'was'. The plural verbs 'were', 'have been' and 'are' do not agree with 'each' even though 'students' follows.

questions.question: I ___ in Raipur since 2015.
questions.explanation: An action that started in the past and continues now, with 'since' and a point of time, takes the Present Perfect Continuous (or Present Perfect). 'Live', 'am living' and 'lived' do not express this link.

questions.question: Choose the verb form of the adjective 'broad'.
questions.explanation: Adding the suffix '-en' to the adjective gives the verb 'broaden'. 'Breadth' and 'broadness' are nouns and 'broadly' is an adverb.

questions.question: Complete the common lexical bundle: '___ the other hand, the plan is costly.'
questions.explanation: 'On the other hand' is a fixed lexical bundle used to introduce a contrast. The other prepositions do not form the bundle.

questions.question: 'To bite the bullet' means ___.
options: to face a difficult situation with courage
questions.explanation: The idiom means to accept and bear an unpleasant situation bravely. It has nothing to do with eating, rudeness or attacking.

questions.question: 'The classroom was a zoo when the teacher left.' Identify the figure of speech.
questions.explanation: The classroom is directly called a zoo without 'like' or 'as', so it is a metaphor.

questions.question: Which suffix, added to 'child', forms a noun?
questions.explanation: 'Child' + '-hood' = 'childhood'. The other suffixes do not form a word with 'child'.

questions.question: In which sentence does the word 'bark' mean the outer covering of a tree?
options: The bark of the old oak was rough and thick.
The dog began to bark at midnight.
His bark is worse than his bite.
questions.explanation: Only the first sentence refers to the covering of a tree; in the others 'bark' is a sound.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: 'She cannot ___ the noise any longer.'
questions.explanation: 'Bear' means to tolerate. 'Bare' means naked/empty, 'beer' is a drink, 'bier' is a stand for a coffin.

questions.question: Choose the correct collocation: 'We should ___ a decision before Friday.'
questions.explanation: The standard collocation is 'make a decision'. 'Do', 'give' and 'have' do not collocate with 'decision' in this sense.

questions.question: 'A piece of cake' means ___.
questions.explanation: The idiom means something that is very easy to do.

questions.question: 'He is as brave as a lion' is an example of ___.
questions.explanation: A direct comparison using 'as...as' is a simile. A metaphor would say 'He is a lion' without 'as/like'.

questions.question: Choose the correct noun formed from the verb 'amuse' by adding a suffix.
questions.explanation: The suffix '-ment' forms the noun 'amusement'. The other forms do not exist in English.

questions.question: In which sentence does 'bear' mean 'to tolerate'?
options: A bear lives in the forest.
The branch cannot bear his weight.
She will bear a child soon.
I cannot bear this noise any longer.
questions.explanation: In the last sentence 'bear' means 'put up with'. In the others it means an animal, to support a weight and to give birth respectively.

questions.question: 'To cry over spilt milk' means ___.
options: to regret something that cannot be undone
to be careless in the kitchen
questions.explanation: The idiom means to feel sorry about a loss or mistake that cannot be reversed. It is not literal.

questions.question: Choose the correct collocation: 'He is a ___ smoker.'
questions.explanation: 'Heavy smoker' is the standard collocation. 'Strong', 'big' and 'hard' are not used with 'smoker' in this meaning.

questions.question: 'Parting is such sweet sorrow' is an example of ___.
questions.explanation: 'Sweet sorrow' joins two contradictory words, which is an oxymoron. It is not a metaphor, alliteration or an address to an absent person.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does the length of the waggle indicate?
questions.explanation: The passage says 'the length of the waggle reveals the distance'. Direction is shown by the angle of the run, not its length.

questions.question: Which of the following can be inferred from the passage?
options: The dance helps the colony use food sources efficiently
The dance is performed outside the hive
The dance warns the hive of predators
Modern scientists have rejected the dance theory
questions.explanation: Since other workers fly directly to the exact spot, the dance helps the colony use food efficiently. The dance is on the honeycomb inside the hive, is about food (not predators), and has been confirmed by experiments.

questions.question: The word 'forager' in the passage most nearly means ___.
questions.explanation: A forager is a bee that goes out to search for food such as nectar. The other options refer to different roles.

questions.question: According to the passage, why are engineers interested in the waggle dance?
options: To design robots that cooperate efficiently
To measure the angle of the sun
questions.explanation: The last sentence says engineers hope to design robots that cooperate as efficiently as a hive.

questions.question: Why did scientists doubt the waggle dance earlier?
options: They thought insects could not convey such precise information
Bees danced too fast to observe
questions.explanation: The passage states scientists doubted that insects could pass on such precise information. The remaining reasons are not mentioned.

questions.question: The 'dry well' in the poem suggests ___.
options: loss and decline of village life
questions.explanation: A dry, still well with a limp rope symbolises decline and loss. It cannot suggest abundance, and the poem mentions no festival or danger.

questions.question: 'The old banyan ... has watched our hopes and silent fears' uses which device?
questions.explanation: The tree is described as watching like a person, which is personification. No 'like/as' comparison or exaggeration is used.

questions.question: 'The potter's wheel has ceased to turn' indicates that ___.
options: the potter is on a journey
questions.explanation: A stopped wheel and cold kiln show that the traditional craft has declined. The other options contradict this.

questions.question: The rhyme scheme of the poem is ___.
questions.explanation: Lines rhyme in pairs: still/hill, near/here, years/fears, low/go and so on, forming rhyming couplets (aabb).

questions.question: The central message of the poem is that ___.
options: traditions and memories must be preserved for future renewal
trees are more valuable than wells
questions.explanation: The last lines say that what we guard in memory will 'green again', so the poem urges preserving heritage. The other options are not supported.

questions.question: The writer argues that ___.
options: libraries decline mainly because of poor management, not just technology
questions.explanation: The writer calls the smartphone explanation 'incomplete' and blames short opening hours and lack of new books. The other statements are not argued.

questions.question: The phrase 'convenient but incomplete' implies that the explanation ___.
options: has some truth but ignores other causes
questions.explanation: 'Incomplete' means partly true but not the whole picture. 'Wholly false' or 'irrelevant' would be too strong.

questions.question: 'If the doors are closed at the very time readers are free, can we blame the readers?' is an example of ___.
questions.explanation: The question is asked for effect, not to get an answer, so it is rhetorical.

questions.question: The word 'footfalls' in the passage means ___.
questions.explanation: In this context 'footfalls' means the number of people visiting the library. The other meanings do not fit.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT suggested by the writer?
options: Buying a few new books every month
questions.explanation: The writer suggests longer hours, new books and a children's corner. Charging fees is never mentioned.

questions.question: Bruner's 'spiral curriculum' means ___.
questions.questionHi: ब्रूनर के 'स्पाइरल करिकुलम' का अर्थ है ___।
options: revisiting concepts at increasing levels of complexity
optionsHi: किसी विषय को केवल एक बार पढ़ाना
अवधारणाओं को बढ़ते हुए स्तर पर बार-बार दोहराना
questions.explanation: A spiral curriculum brings back the same concepts repeatedly, each time at a deeper level.
questions.explanationHi: स्पाइरल करिकुलम में वही अवधारणाएँ बार-बार, हर बार अधिक गहराई के साथ पढ़ाई जाती हैं।

questions.question: A critical perspective on teaching grammar holds that grammar should mainly be taught ___.
questions.questionHi: व्याकरण शिक्षण पर आलोचनात्मक दृष्टिकोण के अनुसार व्याकरण मुख्यतः ___ पढ़ाया जाना चाहिए।
options: as a tool for communicating ideas
optionsHi: विचारों के संप्रेषण के साधन के रूप में
questions.explanation: Modern views treat grammar as a means to communicate meaning in speech and writing, not as isolated rules to be memorised.
questions.explanationHi: आधुनिक मत व्याकरण को बोलने और लिखने में अर्थ संप्रेषित करने का साधन मानते हैं, रटने योग्य अलग नियम नहीं।

questions.question: The Natural Approach to language teaching was developed by ___.
questions.questionHi: भाषा शिक्षण के Natural Approach का विकास ___ ने किया।
questions.explanation: The Natural Approach (1983) was proposed by Stephen Krashen and Tracy Terrell, based on acquisition and comprehensible input.
questions.explanationHi: Natural Approach (1983) क्रैशेन और टेरेल ने प्रस्तुत किया, जो acquisition और comprehensible input पर आधारित है।

questions.question: A learning difficulty marked by persistent problems in handwriting and written expression is called ___.
questions.questionHi: हस्तलेख और लिखित अभिव्यक्ति में लगातार कठिनाई वाली अधिगम समस्या को ___ कहते हैं।
questions.explanation: Dysgraphia affects writing. Dyslexia affects reading and dyscalculia affects mathematics.
questions.explanationHi: डिस्ग्राफिया लेखन को प्रभावित करता है। डिस्लेक्सिया पढ़ने और डिस्कैलकुलिया गणित को प्रभावित करता है।

questions.question: Which of the following is a multilingual resource of the classroom?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन कक्षा का बहुभाषी संसाधन है?
options: Students' home languages and local stories
optionsHi: विद्यार्थियों की घरेलू भाषाएँ और स्थानीय कहानियाँ
questions.explanation: The languages and stories children bring from home are the classroom's multilingual resource. The other options are single-language or non-resource items.
questions.explanationHi: बच्चे घर से जो भाषाएँ और कहानियाँ लाते हैं वे कक्षा का बहुभाषी संसाधन हैं। अन्य विकल्प ऐसे नहीं हैं।

questions.question: Remedial teaching is meant for ___.
questions.questionHi: उपचारात्मक शिक्षण ___ के लिए होता है।
options: learners with specific learning gaps identified by diagnosis
optionsHi: सभी शिक्षार्थियों के लिए समान रूप से
निदान द्वारा पहचानी गई विशिष्ट अधिगम कमियों वाले शिक्षार्थियों के लिए
questions.explanation: Remedial teaching follows diagnosis of particular difficulties and gives targeted help. It is not for all learners alike, nor only for toppers or teachers.
questions.explanationHi: उपचारात्मक शिक्षण में पहले कठिनाइयों का निदान होता है और फिर लक्षित सहायता दी जाती है। यह सभी, केवल अव्वल विद्यार्थियों या शिक्षकों के लिए नहीं है।

questions.question: Using real objects such as fruits and tools to teach vocabulary is called the use of ___.
questions.questionHi: शब्दावली सिखाने के लिए फल और औज़ार जैसी असली वस्तुओं के प्रयोग को ___ कहते हैं।
questions.explanation: Realia are real objects from everyday life used in the classroom to make meaning concrete.
questions.explanationHi: Realia रोज़मर्रा की असली वस्तुएँ हैं जिनसे कक्षा में अर्थ को ठोस रूप में समझाया जाता है।

questions.question: Noam Chomsky proposed that children are born with ___.
questions.questionHi: नोम चॉम्स्की ने प्रस्ताव दिया कि बच्चे जन्म से ___ लेकर पैदा होते हैं।
questions.explanation: Chomsky's nativist theory says children have an innate Language Acquisition Device. 'Blank slate' and imitation are behaviourist ideas; vocabulary is not inborn.
questions.explanationHi: चॉम्स्की के जन्मजात सिद्धांत के अनुसार बच्चों में जन्मजात LAD होती है। 'कोरी स्लेट' और नकल व्यवहारवादी विचार हैं; शब्दावली जन्मजात नहीं होती।

questions.question: B. F. Skinner viewed language learning as ___.
questions.questionHi: बी. एफ. स्किनर भाषा सीखने को ___ मानते थे।
options: a result of operant conditioning through reinforcement
optionsHi: पुनर्बलन द्वारा क्रियाप्रसूत अनुबंधन का परिणाम
questions.explanation: Skinner's behaviourism explains language as a habit formed by operant conditioning, reinforcement and imitation. The other options describe Chomsky, Piaget and Vygotsky.
questions.explanationHi: स्किनर के व्यवहारवाद में भाषा क्रियाप्रसूत अनुबंधन, पुनर्बलन और अनुकरण से बनी आदत है। अन्य विकल्प चॉम्स्की, पियाजे और वाइगोत्स्की के विचार हैं।

questions.question: The study of the structure of words and their smallest meaningful units is called ___.
questions.questionHi: शब्दों की संरचना और उनकी सबसे छोटी अर्थपूर्ण इकाइयों के अध्ययन को ___ कहते हैं।
questions.explanation: Morphology studies word structure and morphemes. Phonology studies sounds, syntax studies sentence structure and pragmatics studies language use in context.
questions.explanationHi: रूपविज्ञान शब्द-संरचना और रूपिमों का अध्ययन करता है। Phonology ध्वनियों, Syntax वाक्य-रचना और Pragmatics संदर्भ में प्रयोग का अध्ययन करता है।

questions.question: Pragmatics deals with ___.
questions.questionHi: Pragmatics (प्रयोगविज्ञान) का संबंध ___ से है।
questions.explanation: Pragmatics studies how meaning depends on context, speaker intention and social situation. Sounds, sentence structure and word formation belong to phonology, syntax and morphology.
questions.explanationHi: Pragmatics में अध्ययन होता है कि अर्थ संदर्भ, वक्ता के उद्देश्य और सामाजिक स्थिति पर कैसे निर्भर करता है। अन्य विकल्प अन्य शाखाओं के हैं।

questions.question: The Audio-Lingual Method is based on ___.
questions.questionHi: श्रव्य-भाषिक विधि (Audio-Lingual Method) ___ पर आधारित है।
questions.explanation: The method uses drills, repetition and reinforcement, following behaviourist habit-formation. The other options are not its theoretical base.
questions.explanationHi: यह विधि अभ्यास, दोहराव और पुनर्बलन का प्रयोग करती है, जो व्यवहारवादी आदत-निर्माण पर आधारित है।

questions.question: In Task-Based Language Teaching, the main unit of instruction is ___.
questions.questionHi: कार्य-आधारित भाषा शिक्षण (TBLT) में शिक्षण की मुख्य इकाई ___ है।
questions.explanation: TBLT organises lessons around real-life tasks that learners complete using the language. Rules, translation and spelling lists are not its core units.
questions.explanationHi: TBLT में पाठ वास्तविक जीवन के कार्यों पर आधारित होते हैं जिन्हें शिक्षार्थी भाषा के प्रयोग से पूरा करते हैं।

questions.question: In Vygotsky's theory, the 'Zone of Proximal Development' is ___.
questions.questionHi: वाइगोत्स्की के सिद्धांत में 'निकटतम विकास का क्षेत्र' (ZPD) ___ है।
options: what the learner can do alone
the gap between what a learner can do alone and with guidance
tasks that are too difficult for anyone
optionsHi: जो शिक्षार्थी अकेले कर सकता है
जो शिक्षार्थी अकेले और मार्गदर्शन के साथ कर सकता है, उसके बीच का अंतर
वे कार्य जो किसी के लिए बहुत कठिन हैं
questions.explanation: ZPD is the distance between independent performance and performance with help from a more capable person. The other options do not define it.
questions.explanationHi: ZPD स्वतंत्र प्रदर्शन और किसी सक्षम व्यक्ति की सहायता से प्रदर्शन के बीच की दूरी है। अन्य विकल्प इसे परिभाषित नहीं करते।

questions.question: 'Interlanguage' refers to ___.
questions.questionHi: 'अंतर्भाषा' (Interlanguage) का अर्थ ___ है।
options: the learner's developing language system between L1 and L2
optionsHi: L1 और L2 के बीच शिक्षार्थी की विकसित होती भाषा-प्रणाली
questions.explanation: Selinker's term 'interlanguage' denotes the learner's evolving system that lies between the first and the target language. It is neither the mother tongue nor native-speaker language.
questions.explanationHi: सेलिंकर का शब्द 'अंतर्भाषा' शिक्षार्थी की उस विकसित होती प्रणाली को कहता है जो पहली भाषा और लक्ष्य भाषा के बीच होती है।

questions.question: A child who starts bed-wetting after a new sibling is born shows the defence mechanism of ___.
questions.questionHi: नए भाई/बहन के जन्म के बाद बिस्तर गीला करने लगने वाला बच्चा ___ नामक रक्षा-युक्ति दिखाता है।
questions.explanation: Regression is returning to an earlier, immature stage of behaviour under stress.
questions.explanationHi: तनाव में पहले की अपरिपक्व अवस्था के व्यवहार पर लौट आना प्रत्यावर्तन (regression) कहलाता है।

questions.question: A dog salivating at the sound of a bell after it was repeatedly paired with food is an example of ___.
questions.questionHi: भोजन के साथ बार-बार घंटी बजाने के बाद केवल घंटी की आवाज़ पर कुत्ते की लार टपकना ___ का उदाहरण है।
questions.explanation: Pavlov's experiment pairs a neutral stimulus with an unconditioned stimulus until it produces the response, which is classical conditioning. Operant conditioning depends on consequences, insight on sudden understanding, and trial and error on repeated attempts.
questions.explanationHi: पावलोव के प्रयोग में तटस्थ उद्दीपक को स्वाभाविक उद्दीपक के साथ जोड़ा जाता है, यह शास्त्रीय अनुबंधन है। क्रियाप्रसूत अनुबंधन परिणामों पर, अंतर्दृष्टि अचानक समझ पर और प्रयास-त्रुटि बार-बार प्रयासों पर आधारित है।

questions.question: Howard Gardner's theory of intelligence proposes ___.
questions.questionHi: हावर्ड गार्डनर का बुद्धि सिद्धांत ___ प्रस्तावित करता है।
options: three intelligences: analytic, creative and practical
at least eight relatively independent intelligences
optionsHi: तीन बुद्धियाँ: विश्लेषणात्मक, सृजनात्मक और व्यावहारिक
कम से कम आठ अपेक्षाकृत स्वतंत्र बुद्धियाँ
questions.explanation: Gardner's Multiple Intelligences theory lists at least eight independent intelligences. The 'g' factor is Spearman's, the triarchic theory is Sternberg's, and Gardner does not say only IQ matters.
questions.explanationHi: गार्डनर का बहुबुद्धि सिद्धांत कम से कम आठ स्वतंत्र बुद्धियाँ बताता है। 'g' कारक स्पीयरमैन का, त्रिचापीय सिद्धांत स्टर्नबर्ग का है और गार्डनर केवल IQ को महत्व नहीं देते।

questions.question: Lawrence Kohlberg's theory is concerned with ___.
questions.questionHi: लॉरेंस कोहलबर्ग का सिद्धांत ___ से संबंधित है।
questions.explanation: Kohlberg proposed three levels (pre-conventional, conventional, post-conventional) of moral development. Cognitive is Piaget, psychosexual is Freud, and psychosocial is Erikson.
questions.explanationHi: कोहलबर्ग ने नैतिक विकास के तीन स्तर (पूर्व-परंपरागत, परंपरागत, उत्तर-परंपरागत) बताए। संज्ञानात्मक विकास पियाजे, मनोलैंगिक फ्रायड और मनोसामाजिक एरिक्सन से जुड़ा है।

questions.question: At the top of Maslow's hierarchy of needs is ___.
questions.questionHi: मैस्लो की आवश्यकता-पदानुक्रम में सबसे ऊपर ___ है।
questions.explanation: Maslow's pyramid runs from physiological, safety, love/belonging and esteem up to self-actualisation at the top.
questions.explanationHi: मैस्लो का पिरामिड शारीरिक, सुरक्षा, प्रेम/अपनत्व और सम्मान से होकर सबसे ऊपर आत्म-सिद्धि तक जाता है।

questions.question: Which of the following is a projective test of personality?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से व्यक्तित्व का प्रक्षेपी परीक्षण (projective test) कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: The Rorschach Inkblot Test is a projective test. The others measure intelligence.
questions.explanationHi: रोर्शाक इंकब्लॉट परीक्षण प्रक्षेपी परीक्षण है। अन्य बुद्धि मापते हैं।

questions.question: Assessment carried out during instruction to improve learning is called ___.
questions.questionHi: शिक्षण के दौरान अधिगम को बेहतर बनाने के लिए किया जाने वाला आकलन ___ कहलाता है।
questions.explanation: Formative assessment is ongoing and gives feedback to improve teaching and learning. Summative assessment is at the end, and a diagnostic test identifies specific difficulties.
questions.explanationHi: रचनात्मक आकलन निरंतर चलता है और अधिगम सुधारने के लिए फीडबैक देता है। योगात्मक आकलन अंत में होता है और निदानात्मक परीक्षण विशिष्ट कठिनाइयाँ पहचानता है।

questions.question: If a test gives consistent results when repeated under similar conditions, it is said to have ___.
questions.questionHi: यदि कोई परीक्षण समान परिस्थितियों में दोहराने पर एक-सी परिणाम देता है, तो उसमें ___ है।
questions.explanation: Consistency of results is reliability. Validity is measuring what is intended, objectivity is freedom from scorer bias, and usability is practicality.
questions.explanationHi: परिणामों की संगति विश्वसनीयता है। वैधता का अर्थ वही मापना जो मापना है, वस्तुनिष्ठता का अर्थ जाँचकर्ता के पक्षपात से मुक्ति और उपयोगिता का अर्थ व्यावहारिकता है।

questions.question: Comparing a learner's performance with a fixed standard of mastery, not with other learners, is the basis of ___.
questions.questionHi: किसी शिक्षार्थी के प्रदर्शन की तुलना अन्य शिक्षार्थियों से नहीं बल्कि निश्चित दक्षता-मानक से करना ___ का आधार है।
questions.explanation: Criterion-referenced testing judges performance against a predefined standard. Norm-referenced testing compares learners with each other.
questions.explanationHi: मापदंड-संदर्भित परीक्षण पूर्वनिर्धारित मानक से प्रदर्शन जाँचता है। मानक-संदर्भित परीक्षण में शिक्षार्थियों की आपस में तुलना होती है।

questions.question: A scoring guide that lists criteria and levels of performance is called a ___.
questions.questionHi: मानदंडों और प्रदर्शन-स्तरों को सूचीबद्ध करने वाली अंकन-मार्गदर्शिका ___ कहलाती है।
questions.explanation: A rubric describes criteria and performance levels for scoring. A blueprint plans a test, an anecdotal record notes incidents, and a cumulative record stores long-term data.
questions.explanationHi: रूब्रिक अंकन के लिए मानदंड और प्रदर्शन-स्तर बताता है। ब्लूप्रिंट परीक्षण की योजना है, उपाख्यानात्मक अभिलेख घटनाएँ दर्ज करता है और संचयी अभिलेख दीर्घकालीन आँकड़े रखता है।

questions.question: NCF 2005 recommends ___.
questions.questionHi: NCF 2005 ___ की सिफ़ारिश करता है।
options: connecting knowledge to life outside school and moving away from rote learning
a single textbook for all learning
optionsHi: ज्ञान को विद्यालय के बाहर के जीवन से जोड़ना और रटने से दूर जाना
सभी अधिगम के लिए एक ही पाठ्यपुस्तक
questions.explanation: NCF 2005 stresses connecting learning with life outside school and reducing rote learning. The other options go against its spirit.
questions.explanationHi: NCF 2005 अधिगम को विद्यालय के बाहर के जीवन से जोड़ने और रटने को कम करने पर बल देता है। अन्य विकल्प इसकी भावना के विपरीत हैं।

questions.question: A lesson plan mainly helps the teacher to ___.
questions.questionHi: पाठ योजना शिक्षक की मुख्यतः ___ में सहायता करती है।
options: organise objectives, content, activities and evaluation systematically
optionsHi: उद्देश्यों, सामग्री, गतिविधियों और मूल्यांकन को व्यवस्थित करने
questions.explanation: A lesson plan gives a systematic structure to objectives, content, methods and evaluation. It does not aim at avoiding books, cutting time or skipping evaluation.
questions.explanationHi: पाठ योजना उद्देश्यों, सामग्री, विधियों और मूल्यांकन को व्यवस्थित ढाँचा देती है। इसका लक्ष्य पुस्तकों से बचना, समय घटाना या मूल्यांकन छोड़ना नहीं है।

questions.question: Group learning in the classroom mainly promotes ___.
questions.questionHi: कक्षा में समूह-अधिगम मुख्यतः ___ को बढ़ावा देता है।
questions.explanation: Working in groups develops cooperation, discussion and learning from peers. The other options do not describe its main purpose.
questions.explanationHi: समूह में कार्य करने से सहयोग, चर्चा और साथियों से सीखना विकसित होता है। अन्य विकल्प इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य नहीं बताते।

questions.question: In a constructivist classroom, the learner is viewed as ___.
questions.questionHi: रचनावादी कक्षा में शिक्षार्थी को ___ माना जाता है।
questions.explanation: Constructivism holds that learners build knowledge actively from experience. The other views belong to the traditional transmission model.
questions.explanationHi: रचनावाद के अनुसार शिक्षार्थी अनुभव से ज्ञान स्वयं सक्रिय रूप से बनाते हैं। अन्य विचार परंपरागत प्रेषण मॉडल के हैं।

questions.question: A gender-sensitive classroom ___.
questions.questionHi: लिंग-संवेदनशील कक्षा ___।
options: treats boys and girls equitably and avoids stereotypes
seats boys and girls separately always
optionsHi: लड़के-लड़कियों से समान व्यवहार करती है और रूढ़ियों से बचती है
लिंग के आधार पर कार्य बाँटती है
विज्ञान में लड़कों को वरीयता देती है
लड़के-लड़कियों को हमेशा अलग बैठाती है
questions.explanation: A gender-sensitive classroom gives equal opportunity and challenges stereotypes. The other options reinforce bias.
questions.explanationHi: लिंग-संवेदनशील कक्षा समान अवसर देती है और रूढ़ियों को चुनौती देती है। अन्य विकल्प पक्षपात को बढ़ाते हैं।

questions.question: 'विद्यालय' शब्द में कौन-सी संधि है?
questions.explanation: विद्या + आलय = विद्यालय। यहाँ 'आ' और 'आ' मिलकर 'आ' बने हैं, इसलिए दीर्घ स्वर संधि है। अन्य संधियों में ऐसा परिवर्तन नहीं होता।

questions.question: 'प्रतिदिन' शब्द में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation: 'प्रतिदिन' (प्रति + दिन = हर दिन) में पहला पद अव्यय है और वही प्रधान है, इसलिए अव्ययीभाव समास है।

questions.question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द 'सूर्य' का पर्यायवाची नहीं है?
questions.explanation: 'शशि' का अर्थ चंद्रमा है। दिनकर, भास्कर और दिवाकर तीनों सूर्य के पर्यायवाची हैं।

questions.question: निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वाक्य चुनिए।
questions.explanation: 'लड़कियाँ खेल रही हैं' में कर्ता और क्रिया के लिंग-वचन सही हैं। अन्य वाक्यों में क्रिया का रूप गलत है, जैसे 'मैं ... पढ़ता हूँ', 'उसने रोटी खाई', 'वह कल आएगा'।

questions.question: 'सुलभ' का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
questions.explanation: 'सुलभ' का विलोम 'दुर्लभ' है। अन्य विकल्प समानार्थी हैं।

questions.question: He is ___ honest man.
questions.explanation: 'Honest' begins with a vowel sound (the 'h' is silent), so 'an' is used. 'A' is used before a consonant sound.

questions.question: One who is fluent in two languages is called ___.
questions.explanation: 'Bilingual' means able to speak two languages. A linguist studies languages, a polyglot knows many languages and an orator is a skilled public speaker.

questions.question: Choose the passive form of 'They are painting the wall.'
options: The wall is being painted by them.
The wall was being painted by them.
The wall has been painted by them.
The wall is painted by them.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous passive is 'is/are being + past participle'. The other options change the tense or aspect.

questions.question: Complete the proverb: 'A stitch in time saves ___.'
questions.explanation: The proverb is 'A stitch in time saves nine', meaning prompt action prevents bigger trouble later.

questions.question: He has been absent ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: 'Since' is used with a point of time (Monday) in the perfect tense. 'For' is used with a period of time.

questions.question: Find the next number in the series: 3, 6, 11, 18, 27, ?
questions.explanation: Differences are 3, 5, 7, 9, so the next difference is 11 and 27 + 11 = 38.

questions.question: If TABLE is written as UBCMF in a code, how will CHAIR be written?
questions.questionHi: यदि किसी कूट में TABLE को UBCMF लिखा जाता है, तो CHAIR को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.explanation: Each letter is moved one step forward: T to U, A to B, B to C, L to M, E to F. So C to D, H to I, A to B, I to J, R to S gives DIBJS.
questions.explanationHi: प्रत्येक अक्षर एक स्थान आगे बढ़ाया गया है: T से U, A से B, B से C, L से M, E से F। अतः C से D, H से I, A से B, I से J, R से S, यानी DIBJS।

questions.question: P is the brother of Q. Q is the sister of R. S is the father of P. How is R related to S?
questions.questionHi: P, Q का भाई है। Q, R की बहन है। S, P का पिता है। R का S से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: P, Q and R are siblings, so R is S's child; the gender of R is not given.
questions.explanationHi: P, Q और R भाई-बहन हैं, इसलिए R, S की संतान है; R का लिंग नहीं दिया गया है।

questions.question: If the day before yesterday was Thursday, what day will it be tomorrow?
questions.questionHi: यदि बीता परसों गुरुवार था, तो आने वाला कल कौन-सा दिन होगा?
questions.explanation: Day before yesterday = Thursday, so today = Saturday and tomorrow = Sunday.
questions.explanationHi: बीता परसों गुरुवार था, तो आज शनिवार है और आने वाला कल रविवार होगा।

questions.question: In a row of 40 students, Anil is 15th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.questionHi: 40 विद्यार्थियों की एक पंक्ति में अनिल बाएँ से 15वें स्थान पर है। दाएँ से उसका स्थान क्या है?
questions.explanation: Position from right = total - position from left + 1 = 40 - 15 + 1 = 26.

questions.question: 1 byte is equal to how many bits?
questions.questionHi: 1 बाइट कितने बिट के बराबर होता है?
questions.explanation: 1 byte = 8 bits.
questions.explanationHi: 1 बाइट = 8 बिट।

questions.question: How many bits are there in one byte?
questions.questionHi: एक बाइट (byte) में कितने बिट (bit) होते हैं?
questions.explanation: One byte is made of 8 bits.
questions.explanationHi: एक byte 8 bits से बनता है।

questions.question: Which protocol provides secure (encrypted) web browsing?
questions.questionHi: कौन-सा प्रोटोकॉल सुरक्षित (एन्क्रिप्टेड) वेब ब्राउज़िंग प्रदान करता है?
questions.explanation: HTTPS uses SSL/TLS encryption. FTP transfers files, SMTP sends mail and POP receives mail.
questions.explanationHi: HTTPS में SSL/TLS एन्क्रिप्शन होता है। FTP फ़ाइल भेजता है, SMTP मेल भेजता है और POP मेल प्राप्त करता है।

questions.question: In MS PowerPoint, a ready-made design that sets colours, fonts and layout of slides is called a ___.
questions.questionHi: MS PowerPoint में स्लाइडों के रंग, फ़ॉन्ट और लेआउट तय करने वाला तैयार डिज़ाइन ___ कहलाता है।
questions.explanation: A theme applies a coordinated set of colours, fonts and effects to all slides.
questions.explanationHi: थीम सभी स्लाइडों पर रंग, फ़ॉन्ट और प्रभावों का एक समन्वित सेट लागू करती है।

questions.question: Every formula in MS Excel begins with which sign?
questions.questionHi: MS Excel में प्रत्येक सूत्र (formula) किस चिह्न से शुरू होता है?
questions.explanation: A formula in Excel must start with the equal sign (=). The other symbols have different uses, for example $ is for absolute references.
questions.explanationHi: Excel में सूत्र बराबर (=) चिह्न से शुरू होना चाहिए। अन्य चिह्नों के अलग उपयोग हैं, जैसे $ निरपेक्ष संदर्भ के लिए।

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability?
questions.questionHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद अस्पृश्यता का अंत करता है?
questions.explanation: Article 17 abolishes untouchability. Article 14 is equality before law, Article 15 prohibits discrimination and Article 16 gives equality of opportunity in public employment.
questions.explanationHi: अनुच्छेद 17 अस्पृश्यता का अंत करता है। अनुच्छेद 14 विधि के समक्ष समता, 15 भेदभाव निषेध और 16 सार्वजनिक नियोजन में अवसर की समानता से संबंधित है।

questions.question: The Cabinet Mission came to India in the year ___.
questions.questionHi: कैबिनेट मिशन भारत ___ में आया था।
questions.explanation: The Cabinet Mission arrived in March 1946 to discuss transfer of power.
questions.explanationHi: कैबिनेट मिशन सत्ता हस्तांतरण पर चर्चा के लिए मार्च 1946 में भारत आया।

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of common salt?
questions.questionHi: सामान्य नमक का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
questions.explanation: Common salt is sodium chloride, NaCl. KCl is potassium chloride, CaCl2 is calcium chloride and Na2CO3 is washing soda.
questions.explanationHi: सामान्य नमक सोडियम क्लोराइड, NaCl है। KCl पोटैशियम क्लोराइड, CaCl2 कैल्शियम क्लोराइड और Na2CO3 धावन सोडा है।

questions.question: The Pandavani folk performance of Chhattisgarh narrates the story of ___.
questions.questionHi: छत्तीसगढ़ की लोक-प्रस्तुति पंडवानी ___ की कथा सुनाती है।
questions.explanation: Pandavani narrates the story of the Pandavas from the Mahabharata; Teejan Bai is its best-known performer. It is not based on the Ramayana, Krishna Leela or Dhola-Maru.
questions.explanationHi: पंडवानी में महाभारत के पांडवों की कथा गाई जाती है; तीजन बाई इसकी प्रसिद्ध कलाकार हैं। यह रामायण, कृष्ण लीला या ढोला-मारू पर आधारित नहीं है।

questions.question: Which is the hardest natural substance?
questions.questionHi: सबसे कठोर प्राकृतिक पदार्थ कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Diamond, a form of carbon, is the hardest natural substance.
questions.explanationHi: हीरा (कार्बन का रूप) सबसे कठोर प्राकृतिक पदार्थ है।
